calls.reason: Google's Q3 2024 remarks say its seven 2-billion-user products, including Maps, run Gemini models, and that AI Overviews in Search reach over 1 billion users a month. That is everyday AI at scale.

The FCC documented an AI-cloned Biden voice used in 2024 robocalls telling voters not to vote, and OpenAI reported state-linked operations using its models to write propaganda. So the misuse he described was real.

In late 2024 Andreessen spoke of a 'local topping out' of model capabilities, Pichai said progress would get harder, and Nadella called scaling laws empirical rather than physical laws. This matches the diminishing returns Marcus predicted, even though Nadella also pointed to test-time scaling.

Stack Overflow found 62% of developers using AI tools, which supports the coder point. But HEPI found only 13% of students generating text for assessments, its author says students mostly don't use AI to write essays, and no survey measures daily use.
